descriptions: A winding house of grey stone stands over the shaft, roofless, its wheel seized with rust.
features: A tally board of miners' tokens. Several hooks are still full.
ambient: Wind whistles across the mouth of the shaft.

descriptions: A tunnel braced with old timbers, some of them bowed under the weight.
A cramped drift cut through dark rock, chisel marks still sharp.
A wide gallery where a seam was followed until it ran out.
A chamber hollowed out by years of digging, its roof held up by pillars of ore.
features: A pick, its handle long rotted, still wedged in the rock face.
ambient: Your lamp-shadow stretches across the far wall.

descriptions: A ladder climbs a shaft into darkness; another descends into the sound of water.
A square shaft drops away beside a ledge barely wide enough to walk.
features: A rope ladder, half its rungs missing.
ambient: A stone falls, and you never hear it land.

descriptions: Water has pooled at the bottom of the workings, black and perfectly still.
A flooded chamber, with a rusted pump standing knee-deep in it.
ambient: Water drips into the sump, steady as a clock.

descriptions: A tall cavity where ore was taken from above, the roof lost in shadow.
A steep stope with old stemples jammed across it like a broken ladder.
features: A miner's candle stub stuck to the wall with clay.
ambient: Somewhere above, something taps on stone.
